title: Electronics & Instrumentation Engineer
experience: M.Tech/PhD with 1–2 years of relevant experience
education: M.Tech/PhD in Electronics, Instrumentation, or related field
description: Design, develop, and deploy advanced electronic and instrumentation systems for defense and critical infrastructure.
responsibilities: Engage with clients to understand requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
Design, develop, and test electronic systems involving sensors, signal conditioning, ADCs, controllers, and power supplies.
Develop and integrate systems with servo motors, advanced control systems, and data acquisition platforms.
Perform PCB assembly, soldering, and troubleshooting.
Work with Raspberry Pi, Jetson Nano, LattePanda, Arduino for embedded development.
Conduct integration tasks: hardware–software interfacing, calibration, and testing.
Support data acquisition and signal processing workflows.
Liaise with vendors for sourcing, quotes, and hardware evaluation.
Prepare technical documentation for designs, tests, and integrations.
Participate in field deployments: installation, commissioning, troubleshooting.
requirements: Proficiency in electronic hardware design and debugging.
Strong knowledge of signal processing, sensor interfacing, and data acquisition.
Hands-on experience with servo motors and control systems.
Familiarity with MATLAB, LabVIEW, PLCs, and SCADA.
Embedded firmware development for microcontrollers.
Knowledge of ruggedized system design for harsh environments.
preferred: Attention to detail and proactive approach.
Ability to work independently under time-sensitive conditions.

Develop and train ML/DL models for predictive modeling and anomaly detection.
Work with time-series data: preprocessing, noise reduction, and feature engineering.
Optimize algorithms for real-time and embedded systems.
Collaborate with hardware, software, and data science teams.
Stay updated on DSP and ML research, propose innovations.
Prepare reports, documentation, and presentations.
requirements: Strong foundation in DSP fundamentals.
Hands-on with Python, MATLAB, or C/C++.
Experience with ML libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn).
Work on time-series/sensor data analysis.
Knowledge of statistics, linear algebra, and optimization.
preferred: Deep learning for time-series (CNNs, RNNs, Transformers).
Experience with DSP processors, FPGAs, GPUs.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
education: B.E./M.Tech in Computer Science or related field

Preprocess and analyze structured/unstructured datasets.
Deploy, monitor, and maintain ML models in production.
Collaborate with data engineering, product, and software teams.
Optimize models for accuracy, latency, and scalability.
Research advancements in ML/AI frameworks and deployment.
requirements: Strong theoretical knowledge of ML algorithms and statistics.
Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras).
Good problem-solving skills and teamwork.

title: Machine Condition Monitoring / Predictive Maintenance Scientist
experience: Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering (IIT/NIT preferred) or M.Tech with experience

description: Research and develop predictive maintenance and condition monitoring techniques for rotating and marine machinery.

Work with accelerometers, microphones, probes, DAQ systems, and signal conditioners.
Develop technical specifications and proposals.
Select and integrate sensors, instrumentation, and vendors.
Analyze health data for diagnostics and failure prediction.
Conduct R&D on predictive maintenance frameworks.
Design and execute experimental studies on mechanical behavior.
Collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams for integration.
Publish research, patents, and novel methodologies.
requirements: Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering (Condition Monitoring, Tribology, Vibration Analysis).
Strong foundation in dynamics, vibration, and signal processing.
Hands-on with diesel/marine engine monitoring.
Proficiency in MATLAB, LabVIEW, or Python.
Knowledge of FFT, STFT, PSD, Wavelet Transform, Envelope Analysis.
offer: Opportunity to apply research in real industrial settings.
Work on marine and heavy-duty engines.
